sections.title: 1. Scope of Data Collection
paragraphs: Zetawala gathers user data to operate, improve, and secure our tools. Collection covers account registration information, API usage parameters, and generation query history.

sections.title: 2. Utilization of Information
paragraphs: Telemetry and payload values are processed to generate relevant outputs over secure connections. User history is locked to individual accounts.

sections.title: 3. Third-Party Integrations & Generative AI
paragraphs: When you use generators, payload parameters such as search queries, niche descriptions, and titles may be forwarded to secure cloud processing environments including Google Gemini API endpoints.

sections.title: 4. User Rights & Data Deletion
paragraphs: Users may inspect, download, or purge generation history and stored states. Requests for complete profile and history erasure are executed via our support channels.

sections.title: 5. Security Standards
paragraphs: Connections to our servers, databases, and third-party models use modern Transport Layer Security (TLS 1.3). Database assets use role-based access control.

sections.title: 1. Acceptable Use of Services
paragraphs: Zetawala grants you a non-exclusive, non-transferable, revocable license to access the platform for generating marketing and metadata outputs.

sections.title: 2. Intellectual Property Rights
paragraphs: Output you generate belongs to you. Underlying system configurations, UI, prompts, and server code remain the exclusive intellectual property of Zetawala.

sections.title: 3. API Usage Limits & Fair Use
paragraphs: To maintain service quality we enforce fair-use rates. Automated batch requests that degrade performance for other users may result in temporary or permanent suspension.

sections.title: 4. Disclaimer of Warranties
paragraphs: Services are provided “as is” and “as available”. We do not guarantee conversion rates, keyword positions, YouTube analytics gains, or campaign results.

sections.title: 5. Limitation of Liability
paragraphs: Zetawala and its developers shall not be liable for indirect, incidental, special, consequential, or punitive damages from downtime, data loss, or model errors.

sections.title: 1. Use of Cookies
paragraphs: Cookies are small text files stored on your device. Zetawala uses cookies to identify sessions, preserve UI preferences, and maintain authentication tokens.

sections.title: 2. Essential Cookies
paragraphs: These cookies are necessary for core site operations such as session security, state persistence, and anti-abuse verification.

sections.title: 3. Managing Preferences
paragraphs: You can modify cookie settings in your browser at any time. Disabling certain cookies may limit access to specific tool features.
